implementation.targetScope: Class, style and decorated-theme composition used by react-autosuggest10.1.0 in VentiMath navigation search. Public keys, selected value ordering and native property-copy behavior checked; application adoption is separate.

changes: Zero dependencies and no copied upstream runtime. Native object spread replaces the legacy object-assign shim.
Preserves enumerable symbols, getter order, later-wins shallow merging and exact key values. A source __proto__ is retained as an own data property instead of changing the output prototype.
Theme lookups remain live and include inherited entries for compatibility. Falsy resolved values are skipped; supplied property names are not prefiltered.

appContract.scope: Actual FuseSearch theme maps passed through unchanged public Autowhatever component; synthetic suggestions and server-rendered output, not authenticated app/visual validation.
